prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one fixed full-body HD prerendered narrative character sprite for Mass Effect — Relay Chronicles, Armax.
Primary request: Dr. Lexi T'Perro in her Mass Effect: Andromeda Tempest medical uniform, alone, standing unarmed in a calm professional neutral three-quarter pose facing slightly right.
Input images: Image 1 shows Lexi on the LEFT of Drack, in profile, and is the reference for her medical outfit and crest. Image 2 shows Lexi on the RIGHT of the human Ryder, and is the reference for her facial identity and front collar/chest. Both are game screenshots. Reproduce Lexi only, not the companions or interface.
Subject: adult blue-skinned asari woman, original Andromeda facial proportions and swept-back ridged scalp crest, small dark facial markings as visible. White/light gray high-collared medical tunic reaching upper thigh; coral red raised collar, red asymmetric upper-chest panel edged with thin light lines, dark narrow seam at chest, red side panels continuing down the hips, white upper sleeves with red medical insignia and blue Initiative patch. Slim dark charcoal trousers, simple low dark practical shoes, not armor; lower shins and shoes are conservatively reconstructed where references are cropped. Hands relaxed, no datapad or omniblade, no weapon.
Style: realistic HD 3D prerendered game sprite with readable fabric, matte medical uniform, natural adult body proportions, soft neutral upper-left light. Her crest, face and clothing must remain specifically Lexi; no Liara, Peebee, Aria, ornate armor, leather jacket or exposed midriff.
Composition: one complete body from crest tip to soles, centered on a portrait canvas, subject occupying only 78 percent of image height. Generous empty transparent margins of at least ten percent above and below, both feet fully visible, no floor, no scene, no duplicate body, no text, no watermark. True transparent RGBA background; avoid fog and decorative glow.
